## Darknet.ps() method

List running scripts on a server.

**Signature:**

```typescript
ps(host?: string, password?: string): ProcessInfo[];
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  host | string | _(Optional)_ Host address of the target server. If not specified, it will be the current server by default. |
|  password | string | _(Optional)_ Password to authenticate with the target server. Not required for running scripts on the current server. |
